lines.text: تأرجح ذراع البندول (اليمين). ادعم نفسك على الطاولة باليد الأخرى ودع ذراعك الأيمن يتدلى ويتأرجح برفق في دوائر صغيرة. دقيقة واحدة، 3 مرات في اليوم. اعتمد على الطاولة بيدك اليسرى. دع ذراعك الأيمن يتدلى ويتأرجح برفق في دوائر صغيرة. صغيرة ومسترخية. الذراع يتدلى فقط.
lines.source_en: Pendulum arm swing (right). Support yourself on a table with the other hand and let your right arm hang and swing gently in small circles. 1 minute, 3 times a day. Lean on the table with your left hand. Let the right arm hang and swing gently in small circles. Small and relaxed. The arm just hangs.
lines.back_translation: Pendulum arm swing (right). Support yourself on the table with the other hand and let your right arm hang and swing gently in small circles. One minute, 3 times a day. Rely on the table with your left hand. Let your right arm hang and swing gently in small circles. Small and relaxed. The arm only hangs.

lines.text: دوران للخارج مع شريط (اليمين). حافظ على المرفق ملاصقًا لجانبك وحوّض الساعد للخارج ضد الشريط. 3 × 10، كل يوم. حافظ على مرفقك مغروسًا في جانبك. قريب من جسمك، كما لو كنت تمسك صحيفة تحت إبطك.
lines.source_en: Outward rotation with a band (right). Keep the elbow against your side and turn the forearm outwards against the band. 3 × 10, every day. Keep your elbow tucked in against your side. Close to your body, as if you were holding a newspaper under your arm.
lines.back_translation: External rotation with a band (right). Keep the elbow close to your side and rotate the forearm outwards against the band. 3 x 10, every day. Keep your elbow planted in your side. Close to your body, as if you were holding a newspaper under your arm.

lines.text: جري مع شريط (الجانبين). اسحب الشريط نحوك بكلتا يديك، واضغط لوحي الكتف معًا. 2 × 15، كل يوم. امسك الشريط بكلتا يديك واسحبه نحوك. اضغط لوحي الكتف معًا.
lines.source_en: Rowing with a band (both sides). Pull the band towards you with both hands, squeezing the shoulder blades together. 2 × 15, every day. Hold the band with both hands and pull it towards you. Squeezing the shoulder blades together.
lines.back_translation: Rowing with a band (both sides). Pull the band towards you with both hands and press the shoulder blades together. 2 x 15, every day. Hold the band with both hands and pull it towards you. Press the shoulder blades together.

lines.text: تمطيط العضلة الخلفية للفخذ (لم يُذكر الجانب). اجلس ورجلك (لم يُذكر الجانب) مستقيمة أمامك وانحنِ للأمام من الوركين حتى تشعر بتمطيط خلف الفخذ. لم تُذكر الجرعة، ولم يُذكر التكرار. من سجلاتك: انحنِ من الوركين واحافظ على استقامة الظهر.
lines.source_en: Seated hamstring stretch (side not stated). Sit with your (side not stated) leg straight in front of you and lean forward from the hips until you feel a stretch behind the thigh. Dose not stated, how often not stated. From your records: Bend from the hips and keep the back straight.
lines.back_translation: Hamstring stretch (side not mentioned). Sit with your (side not mentioned) leg straight in front of you and bend forward from the hips until you feel a stretch behind the thigh. Dose not mentioned, how often not mentioned. From your records: bend from the hips and keep the back straight.
